Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a taxi driver, the other a professor. The professor unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the taxi driver was a delight, though! Who is uninvolved in their kids' education?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The professor
C. The taxi driver
